title: Surge reservoirs & fast-path autoscale pilot: Q2 dedicated capacity roadmap
creator: Riley Chen
description: Goal: design and run a quarter-long pilot that reduces tail latency and customer-facing throttling for Dedicated pools during sudden traffic spikes while keeping unit cost growth constrained. Problem: dedicated pools see periodic burst events (marketing launches, model retrains, third-party traffic spikes) where our current autoscaler either reacts too slowly (adding cold GPU capacity) or overprovisions (higher monthly costs). Hypothesis: a small, managed "surge reservoir" (warm held capacity + fast-path allocation logic) plus a fast-path allocation policy will absorb common spike patterns, reducing p99 tail latency by >=20% during spike windows without increasing average hourly cost by more than 10% for pilot customers. This ticket scopes roadmap planning, experiment definition, rollout phases, success metrics, guardrails, and cross-team dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot architecture documented and approved by Eng+SRE+PM+Finance
Two paying pilot customers enrolled and signed up for data collection (non-prod mirrored traffic allowed)
Runbook and rollback plan created and reviewed
Observability: Grafana dashboards instrumented for p50/p95/p99 latency, cold-start rate, reservation usage, and unit cost; alerting thresholds created
Quantitative success: during at least 3 observed burst events, p99 latency reduction >=20% compared to baseline and cost delta <= +10% over the pilot period
No increase in customer-facing 5xx errors attributable to allocation policy change
Console UI: basic toggle to enable/disable reservoir per-pool available for canary customers
Post-pilot analysis with recommendations (scale, pricing adjustments, GA readiness) completed
tasks: Define surge reservoir sizing heuristics (percentile-based + event window) - owner: Eng
Prototype fast-path allocation changes in serving runtime and scheduler - owner: Eng
Create autoscale policy model & UI wires in Console - owner: PM/Design
Telemetry: add metrics (reservoir utilization, allocation-latency, queue depth) and dashboards - owner: SRE
Cost model simulation using historical traffic traces - owner: FinOps + Eng
Runbook & k-change rollback plan - owner: SRE/Support
Recruit two pilot customers and define data-sharing & SLA guardrails - owner: Growth/PM
Canary rollout plan and termination criteria - owner: PM/Eng
metrics: p50/p95/p99 request latency (dedicated pool) - baseline vs pilot
Cold-start count and cold-start latency during spike windows
Allocation decision latency (ms) for fast-path vs normal path
Per-token unit cost delta for pilot pools vs matched controls
Customer-facing error rate (5xx) attributable to allocation logic
